consent.title: Medical notice and consent
consent.lead: Read the notice in full before continuing. No plan is generated until you consent.
consent.point1: FitFlow is a decision-support tool for specialists. It does not replace medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
consent.point2: Every plan the system generates starts as a draft and only reaches you after a human specialist approves it.
consent.point3: Do not stop a medication or disregard your doctor's advice based on anything this app shows you.
consent.point4: Stop immediately and consult a professional if you feel sharp pain, dizziness, or shortness of breath while exercising.
consent.point5: Your health data is used only to build and follow up your plan, and is visible to the specialist assigned to you.
consent.emergency: In an emergency call emergency services immediately — do not use this app.

hero.title: A health plan computed from equations,
hero.titleAccent: approved by a specialist before it reaches you.
hero.body: FitFlow works out your needs with a transparent rule engine and explicit safety bounds, then puts the result in front of a human specialist. No number reaches you unreviewed.
hero.note: No credit card · Sign up in under two minutes
hero.imageAlt: A view of the patient dashboard

how.title: From sign-up to an approved plan in four steps
how.body: Every step is saved the moment you finish it, so you can stop and come back whenever you like.
how.step1Body: Basic details, medical history, your goal and activity level, then food allergies.
how.step2Body: Injury type, stage and pain level, with scans and reports attached if you have them.
how.step3Body: The engine computes your energy and macros and builds your meals, excluding anything you react to.
how.step4Body: The plan stays a draft until a professional reviews and approves it — only then does it appear to you.

features.title: Built to be reviewed, not to look clever
features.body: Every decision in the system is explainable and traceable — because no specialist can sign off on a health tool that cannot explain itself.
features.item1Title: A rule engine, not a black box
features.item1Body: Every number comes from a published equation with explicit safety bounds: a calorie floor, a deficit ceiling, and limits on protein and fat.
features.item2Body: Unsafe items are dropped from the selection space entirely, so they never enter a plan and get filtered out later — the difference between safety and luck.
features.item3Body: An acute injury automatically takes priority over any other goal and blocks anything that could harm the affected area.
features.item4Body: Weight, pain and adherence are plotted over time, and plateaus or unsafe rates of loss are detected early.
features.item5Body: Every view of a patient record and every status change is logged — accountability covers reads, not just writes.
features.item6Body: A fully right-to-left Arabic interface designed as such rather than translated, with complete English one click away.

safety.title: AI explains. It never decides.
safety.body: Separating computation, explanation and approval is not a UI detail — it is enforced at the database level.
safety.point1: The engine computes the numbers. AI explains them in plain language. Only the specialist approves them.
safety.point2: No path in the system can return a draft or in-review plan to a patient.
safety.point3: A patient sees only their own data; a specialist sees only the patients assigned to them.
safety.point4: If the AI fails completely, plans are still generated and shown as numbers — the platform does not depend on it.
safety.imageAlt: Diagram of the plan approval cycle

faq.title: Before you start
faq.q1: Is this a replacement for my doctor?
faq.a1: No. FitFlow is a decision-support tool for specialists, not a substitute for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Any plan you receive has been reviewed and approved by a human specialist.
faq.q2: How long does the first plan take?
faq.a2: Signing up and completing your profile takes about two minutes, and generation is instant. The real wait depends on the specialist's review.
faq.q3: What if I have an active injury?
faq.a3: Record it on the injuries screen. An acute injury automatically shifts your plan's priority to rehabilitation, and the system blocks anything that could harm the affected area.
faq.q4: Who can see my health data?
faq.a4: Only you and the specialist assigned to you. Every view of a patient record is written to an append-only audit log.

cta.title: Start with a profile, end with a plan a professional signed off on
cta.body: Signing up is free and needs no card. You can stop at any step and pick it up later.
